diagnosis: Canonical opportunities are qualified daily, but many have neither a future scheduled next action nor an accountable durable review; status and action evidence must remain separate.

prevention.approach: same existing daily Brain loop, no additional scheduler, no second CRM, no new tables
prevention.fairness: max 24 canonical internal review obligations per daily invocation, 8 high-priority slots and remaining capacity for evidence research; deterministic identity
prevention.no_contact: Do not send automated email, LinkedIn DMs or solicit scans from inferred engagement; privacy suppression remains authoritative
prevention.action_truth: PLANNED_NOT_EXECUTED cannot be counted as delivered, provider-confirmed, customer reply or realized revenue
prevention.update_safety: PostgREST conditional exact-opportunity key, open status, and original due-date cutoff; perform upserts before guarded patch
prevention.source_quality: Unverified search/social/news signals produce internal research only; proposals require independent first-party proofs
prevention.completion: Only exact-head Required, CodeQL, native preview when applicable, protected merge, production cron delivery receipt, and durable readback can prove live.

next_proof: read back non-PII follow-up due-date coverage from production after release
root_cause: Canonical opportunities are qualified daily, but many have neither a future scheduled next action nor an accountable durable review; status and action evidence must remain separate.
fix: Use canonical daily growth assessment to produce idempotent, bounded internal review obligations and guarded future next_action_at writeback, without granting contact authority.
terminal_rule: Required and CodeQL on exact head, protected merge and independent production next_action_at and obligation readback are mandatory; planning is not outreach or realized revenue.
